body.name: Complement-paired context experiment
body.construction: For \(1\leq k<T\) and \(r_0=T-k\), let the first \(k\) covariates and actions be independent fair bits, pair the resulting \(4^k\) contexts by flipping only \(X_1\), set all later covariates to zero, and let \(f_{r_0}(b)=\mathbf 1\{\sum_jb_j>r_0/2\}+\frac12\mathbf 1\{\sum_jb_j=r_0/2\}\). Under \(P_0^{k,r_0}\), the late actions are independent fair bits and \(Y=f_{r_0}(A_{k+1},\ldots,A_T)\). Under each \(P_B^{k,r_0}\), assign to the two contexts in every pair a fixed late string and its bitwise complement, and use the corresponding deterministic outcome. Define \(\overline P_1^{(n,k,r_0)}\) by averaging \((P_B^{k,r_0})^n\) over independent uniform pair strings.
